state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done. Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Connection'` passes: nothing owed, 36 examples and 12 attacks ok.

**The proofs runner runs at most two `requires: samba-ad` programs at once** (`SAMBA_AD_JOBS` in `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`). With a full pool of eight, Samba ran past the blocks' 5 s `timeout`, and connects, calls and setups failed at random. The Connection group now takes about 5 minutes.

**Five `Core\Ldap` features still owe proofs.** `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 1000 | grep -i ldap` lists them: `LdapError` (about, examples, hostile, tests), and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` (about, examples, tests). An enum is not attacked and not benchmarked.

**The whole-roster check also counts features outside this goal.** Most of what `bun nv proofs --gate` names is `Core\Str` stale perf, `lang` and `Core\Db`. The check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-core-ldap` in `data/goals/ldap.json` cannot pass from `Core\Ldap` work alone.

**Two blocks reach `samba-ad`.** `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader`; `[ldap.corp-accounts]` binds as `Administrator` and is granted only to the write proofs' directories. A write attack clears its unit with `Leftovers::clear` (playbook, *Writing a test case*). Every long loop in an attack catches its call and stops at the first error. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`.

**Samba is slow and drops connections.** A 20000-part filter, a 1 MB cookie or a 10000-name `select` makes Samba close the connection, and every later call on it throws `Unavailable`, so an attack puts such a step last and catches every call. The examples filter on `department` `Sales` (Anna Berg, Carla Diaz) because write proofs add users at the same time.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap\LdapError` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): the class is named at `crates/nvs-types/src/error_lib.rs:206` and its `kind` enum at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:2905`. Tests are `covers:` markers on cases that catch it, such as `tests/conformance/core/ldap-authenticate-wrong-password.nvst:4` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:1840`. Its attack copies `Leftovers::clear` if it writes, and catches every call.

**`Core\Ldap\ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): about, three examples and tests each. Their cards are in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:2905`; `bun nv proofs --id '<enum>'` prints the paths.
